programs.title: European Le Mans
programs.desc: With six 4-hour races on Europe's most technical and demanding circuits, the ELMS is the perfect proving ground for any competitor wishing to take on the challenge of the next stage on the endurance ladder, the FIA World Endurance Championship, and the pinnacle of the sport, the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

programs.title: Michelin Le Mans Cup
programs.desc: Over the years, the Michelin Le Mans Cup has become the main series for amateur drivers looking for an introduction to Endurance racing. Launched in 2016, the competition takes place on some of Europe's most iconic circuits. The MLMC is the first step into the world of endurance racing for the young stars of tomorrow.

programs.title: CNBC Sports - Valentino Rossi
programs.desc: An extraordinary personality, global popularity, legendary victory celebrations, and nine motorcycle world championship titles - those are the words to describe Valentino Rossi. Since hanging up his leathers in 2021, Vale, if we may him call him that, has embarked on a career in car racing, and this is where our story begins.
